0ffd644c.yl: Yield: 10 shanks · Portion: ≈ 500 g (bone-in shank ≈ 350 g raw)
c: Season and flour shanks; brown well; remove.
Brown diced veg; add tomato paste 2 min; deglaze with wine; reduce by half.
Return shanks; add stock and aromatics; braise covered 150 °C 3–3.5 h until tender.
Lift shanks; strain and reduce sauce to coating.
Boil peeled parsnip and potato; mash with butter and cream; season.
0ffd644c.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
0ffd644c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%) · 9 Celery (celery, veal stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

f3de0d05.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 330 g (venison 150 g raw)
c: Remove all sinew; season with crushed juniper, pepper and salt.
Sear all sides 3 min; baste with butter and thyme.
Roast 180 °C to core 52–54 °C (6–8 min); rest 8 min (venison is lean: never past medium).
Simmer diced celeriac in milk 20 min; blend very smooth with butter; season.
Sauté stripped kale in oil 2 min; season.
Sweat shallot; add wine and crushed juniper; reduce by two thirds.
Add jus and jelly; simmer to coating; strain; add blackberries; mount with butter.
f3de0d05.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
f3de0d05.al: 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 9 Celery (celeriac, veal jus) · 14 Sulphites (veal jus, red wine)

70760b67.yl: Yield: 10 burgers · Portion: ≈ 420 g (patty 160 g raw)
c: Wild boar belly or back fat
Mince venison with 15 % boar fat (lean venison alone is dry); season with crushed juniper and thyme.
Shape 170 g patties; chill 30 min; grill to core 70 °C (mince: cook through).
Cook sliced onion in butter 15 min; add sugar, wine and vinegar; simmer 30 min to jammy.
Melt sliced smoked cheese on the patties.
Toast buns; mayo, rocket, patty, onion jam.
70760b67.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
70760b67.al: 1 Gluten (brioche burger buns) · 3 Eggs (brioche burger buns, mayonnaise) · 7 Milk (butter, brioche burger buns, smoked cheese) · 14 Sulphites (red wine, red wine vinegar)

c: Use only previously frozen (−18 °C min 7 days) venison from an approved supplier.
Roll the loin in crushed juniper, pepper and thyme; sear 20 s each side; chill; wrap tight; freeze 1 h.
Slice 2 mm on the slicer; lay between oiled film; flatten; plate 70 g.
Pour hot vinegar-sugar over blackberries; cool (pickled berries).
Scatter rocket, crushed hazelnuts, berries and Parmesan; dress with oil.
5c40013c.st: Plate to order; raw meat 0–3 °C, use same day once sliced.
5c40013c.al: 7 Milk (parmesan) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar). Raw meat: not for pregnant guests, children or immunocompromised guests.

d05e2b15.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 × 50 g medallions + 50 ml sauce
c: Remove all silver skin; cut 30 medallions × 60 g; season with salt, pepper and crushed juniper.
Sear in very hot oil 1.5–2 min per side; add butter and thyme; baste 30 s.
Rest 5 min on a rack; serve pink (core 54–56 °C). Venison is lean: never cook past medium.
Sweat shallots in butter; add red wine and port; reduce by ⅔.
Add demi-glace; simmer to sauce consistency; strain.
Add berries and lingonberry jam; warm 1 min (berries stay whole); mount with cold butter.
d05e2b15.st: Raw medallions 0–4 °C 48 h vacuum-packed. Sauce 0–4 °C 4 days. Cook to order.
d05e2b15.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal demi-glace) · 14 Sulphites (red wine, port wine)

66627882.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g stew (meat ≈ 150 g cooked)
c: Cut venison into 4 cm cubes (sinew removed); cover with wine, crushed juniper, bay, thyme and pepper; marinate 12–24 h.
Drain well, keep the wine; pat meat dry.
Brown venison in hot oil in small batches; render lardons; brown onion, carrot and celery 8 min; add garlic and tomato paste 2 min.
Dust with flour, cook 1 min; add the strained marinade, reduce by ⅓; add stock and meat.
Braise covered 160 °C 2 h – 2 h 30 min until tender; skim fat.
Sauté mushrooms in butter; add with the lingonberry jam; season. Serve with spätzle, mash or polenta.
66627882.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (celery stalk, chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

c: Season and sear loins 1 min each side; brush with Dijon; chill.
Chop mushrooms, chestnuts and shallot fine; cook in butter until completely dry; cool.
Lay ham on film, spread duxelles, roll the loin tight; chill 30 min.
Wrap in pastry, seam down; egg-wash; score; chill 20 min.
Bake 210 °C 20–25 min to core 50 °C; rest 10 min (carry-over to 54 °C); slice 4 cm.
Reduce port with shallot by two thirds; add jus; reduce to coating; mount with butter.
933a8806.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
933a8806.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, puff pastry) · 9 Celery (veal jus) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (port wine, veal jus)

c: Season; sear in foaming butter 90 s each side to core 54 °C (pink); rest 4 min; slice.
Crisp pancetta lardons; sweat shallot; add peas and stock; simmer 3 min.
Add shredded lettuce, butter and mint; season.
Reduce Madeira by two thirds; add jus; reduce to coating; mount with butter.
043032fe.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
043032fe.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock, veal jus) · 14 Sulphites (madeira, veal jus)

c: Season; sear skin-side 4 min; turn; baste with butter; finish 180 °C to core 66 °C; rest 5 min (carry-over to 70 °C).
Cut potatoes into 5 cm cylinders; colour in butter; braise in stock 200 °C 30 min until tender.
Shred cabbage; blanch 1 min; toss with crisp lardons and butter.
Sauté apple dice; flame with Calvados; add stock; reduce by half; add cream; reduce to coating.
93742aa3.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.

3535993a.yl: Yield: 10 birds · Portion: 1 bird (≈ 250 g bone-in) + garnish ≈ 420 g
c: Season; sear all over in butter.
Roast 220 °C 12–15 min, breast slightly pink (core 63 °C breast, 70 °C thigh); rest 5 min.
Render diced pancetta; sweat brunoise of onion, carrot and celery.
Add lentils, stock and bay; simmer 20–25 min until tender with a bite; finish with vinegar and parsley.
Deglaze roasting pan with jus; infuse thyme; strain; mount with butter.
3535993a.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
3535993a.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (celery, chicken stock, veal jus) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar, veal jus). Possible lead shot.

ef4cbb7e.yl: Yield: 5 birds · 10 portions × ½ bird (≈ 300 g bone-in)
c: Season birds inside and out; cover breasts with bacon (pheasant is lean).
Sear in butter; roast 200 °C 35–40 min, basting, to core 70 °C thigh; rest 10 min; halve.
Infuse milk with clove-studded onion and bay 20 min; whisk in fresh breadcrumbs, butter and nutmeg.
Deglaze roasting tray with wine and stock; add jelly; reduce; strain.
Serve with house game chips (see Potato Crisps TTK) and watercress.
ef4cbb7e.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
ef4cbb7e.al: 1 Gluten (bread sauce) · 7 Milk (butter, bread sauce) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Possible lead shot: tell guests the bird may contain shot.

c: Start skin-side down in a cold pan; render 6 min; turn 1–2 min to core 55 °C; rest 5 min; slice.
Roast whole beetroot in foil 190 °C 60 min; peel; cut wedges; dress with balsamic.
Caramelise sugar lightly; add port and orange juice; reduce by two thirds.
Add jus and zest; reduce to coating; mount with butter.
7ab543a6.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
7ab543a6.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal jus) · 14 Sulphites (balsamic vinegar, port wine, veal jus). Possible lead shot.

c: Raw 2.8 kg (2 rabbits) → Yield ≈ 2800 g with sauce
Joint rabbits in 10 pieces each; dry; season.
Brown in oil 8–10 min in a wide pan with garlic, rosemary, thyme and bay.
Deglaze with wine, reduce by half; add stock; cover; simmer gently 40–45 min (75 °C core, tender at the leg).
Add olives and toasted pine nuts; uncover and reduce 10 min to a glossy sauce; season.
1a5afa70.al: 8 Nuts (pine nuts) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

62049733.yl: Yield: 10 chops · Portion: ≈ 420 g (chop 300 g raw bone-in)
c: Marinate with oil, crushed juniper and garlic 2 h.
Grill 4–5 min each side; finish 180 °C to core 70 °C (wild boar: always cook through); rest 5 min.
Cut apples in wedges; caramelise in half the butter and sugar.
Foam remaining butter with sage leaves until crisp.
Warm crushed juniper with gin; flame; add jus; reduce slightly; strain.
62049733.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
62049733.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal jus) · 14 Sulphites (veal jus). Wild boar must be Trichinella-tested by the supplier.

c: Raw bone-in 2500 g → picked meat ≈ 1000 g
Marinate hare in wine with juniper and bay overnight; drain (keep wine); pat dry.
Brown hare; remove. Sweat pancetta and soffritto; add tomato paste.
Return hare; add reserved wine and stock; braise covered 150 °C 2.5 h until falling from the bone.
Pick meat; shred; return to the reduced sauce.
Cook pasta al dente; toss with ragù, butter and pasta water; finish with Parmesan.
897c745c.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.
897c745c.al: 1 Gluten (egg pappardelle) · 3 Eggs (egg pappardelle) · 7 Milk (butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (celery, chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

c: Marinate rabbit in wine, vinegar and bay 12 h at 4 °C; drain and pat dry, keep marinade.
Brown rabbit in oil; remove. Brown whole onions 8 min; add garlic and paste 1 min.
Add marinade, tomatoes and spices; return rabbit; braise covered 160 °C 1 h 30 min, core ≥ 75 °C (2500 → ≈ 1600 g).
Reduce sauce until glossy; remove whole spices. Serve with mashed potato or pilafi.
Brown boar in batches in hot oil; set aside.
Sweat finely diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic 8 min; add tomato paste 2 min.
Add wine, reduce by half; add tomatoes, crushed juniper, herbs and meat.
Cover and simmer 2.5–3 h at 150 °C until it shreds (core ≥ 75 °C); pull meat apart with forks; reduce to a thick ragù.
Cook pappardelle 1 min less than packet time.
Toss with hot ragù, butter and a splash of pasta water; finish with Parmesan and parsley.
0861197b.al: 1 Gluten (egg pappardelle) · 3 Eggs (egg pappardelle) · 7 Milk (butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (celery stalk) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

f7f52102.yl: Yield: 20 sausages × 100 g · 10 portions × 2 · Portion: ≈ 380 g
c: Wild boar belly or back fat
Keep meat and equipment at 0–2 °C. Mince boar and fat through 6 mm plate.
Mix with grated apple, seasoning and ice water until tacky; stuff into soaked casings; link 100 g.
Rest overnight 0–3 °C; poach 75 °C 15 min, then colour on the grill (core 72 °C).
Sweat lardons, onion and carrot; add lentils and stock; simmer 25 min.
Reduce cream by a third; whisk in Dijon off heat.
f7f52102.st: Game from approved suppliers only (veterinary-checked); store 0–3 °C, separate from other raw meat; cooked 0–3 °C 3 days.

85b9a6a0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g (meat ≈ 150 g cooked)
c: Marinate boar cubes (4 cm) in wine with juniper, cloves and bay 24 h at 0–4 °C; drain; keep the wine.
Brown meat in batches; brown onion and carrot 8 min; add garlic, tomato paste, flour 2 min.
Add marinade, reduce by ⅓; add stock, rosemary and meat; braise covered 160 °C 2 h 30 min.
Add prunes and sugar for the last 30 min; core ≥ 75 °C (wild boar: always fully cooked, trichinella check from supplier).
Season; serve with polenta, kachamak or potato purée.
85b9a6a0.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Wild boar must come from an approved supplier with veterinary certificate (trichinella tested).

c: Mix cold mince, whites, chopped veg, tomato and juniper; whisk into cold stock.
Bring slowly to a simmer, stirring until the raft forms; then stop stirring.
Simmer gently 1 h through a hole in the raft; ladle through a muslin.
Season consommé; add Madeira; serve very hot over brunoise and chives.

69d94cc2.yl: Yield: 1 pie Ø 22 cm · 12 portions × 180 g
c: Dice meats 1.5 cm (pheasant skinless); mix with chopped shallot, crushed juniper, thyme, port and seasoning; chill 2 h.
Boil water, lard and salt; pour onto flour; mix to a dough; line a greased tin warm, keeping a lid.
Pack filling; lid; crimp; make a steam hole; egg-wash.
Bake 200 °C 30 min, then 160 °C 75 min to core 72 °C; cool 1 h.
Pour warm stock with dissolved gelatine through the hole; chill overnight; slice cold.
69d94cc2.st: 0–3 °C 5 days, whole; cut slices same day.
69d94cc2.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (port wine)

0596d8a8.yl: Yield: ≈ 3 L stock · 30 portions × 100 ml (or 1 L reduced game jus)
c: Roast bones 220 °C 45 min until deep brown; roast veg the last 20 min with tomato paste.
Deglaze tray with wine; place all in pot with cold water and aromatics.
Simmer 6 h, skimming (never boil); strain; chill; remove fat.
For jus: reduce 3 L to 1 L.
0596d8a8.st: Cool to below 5 °C within 90 min; 0–3 °C 4 days or −18 °C 3 months.

c: Soak prunes in brandy 12 h. Bone rabbit; keep loins whole; mince legs, belly and liver 6 mm.
Mix mince with salts, egg, shallots and thyme; layer with loins and prunes in a lined terrine.
Bake in a water bath 150 °C to core 68 °C; press 1 kg; chill 24 h.
Brown game trimmings (if available) with diced shallot, carrot and celery in oil 8 min.
Add crushed juniper, thyme and bay; deglaze with vinegar; reduce almost dry.
Add red wine; reduce by ⅔; add demi-glace; simmer 30 min, skimming.
Add coarsely crushed pepper for the last 8 min only (otherwise bitter); strain through a chinois.
Finish with lingonberry jam and cold butter; check salt.
e0d61ff7.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (celery stalk, veal demi-glace) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar, red wine)
